messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — cutoff for v1.12.0 changelog entries is today at 17:00 PT. If you have anything user-facing, please add a single-line entry and tag the PR. :memo:

jess: Thanks! Quick format check — should entries be sentence case or fragment style? Also where do we link the PR?

amazon: fragment-style is preferred (like 'Improve routing fallback for low-memory GPUs'). Put PR link at the end: (PR #1234). No period.

sam: For breaking changes, prefix with BREAKING: and include migration notes on the PR description. Example: BREAKING: change KV cache key format — consumers must clear cache.

maria: Is there a template we should copy? I pulled something from docs but want to make sure it's the latest.

release-coordinator: Use the release-notes template in /docs/release-notes.md — tl;dr: one short summary line, optional detail paragraph (1-2 sentences), PR link, and tags like [bug], [perf], [infra], [feat]. Please avoid long prose.

jess: Got it. I'll add my entry. Also who is handling the version bump for packages? We need package.json and the deployment manifest updated.

sam: I can take the version bump. Planning to open a PR against release/v1.12 by 16:00 PT. Please don't merge directly to main after cutoff — we cut from release/v1.12 and fast-follow any hotfixes.

devops: Reminder: if you need a cherry-pick, use `git cherry-pick -x <commit>` onto release/v1.12 and add label `release/cherry-pick`. We will run the release pipeline from that branch.

alex: Small policy note — doc-only changes should include the label `changelog: no` so the automated changelog linter skips them. If it's a user-visible change, include `changelog: yes`.

release-bot: :rotating_light: Automated changelog linter will run at 16:50 PT and will post failures here. Fixes after 17:00 PT require explicit approval from @release-coordinator.

jess: One more ask — can we standardize PR titles for entries? Something like `release(notes): add entry for PR #1234 — feat` so the linter picks it up.

release-coordinator: Yep — PR title template accepted. Also if you're tagging an external customer-facing change, ping @maria and I'll add the release note blurb for marketing.

alex: Thanks all. TL;DR: add short fragment entry + PR link, use template, label doc-only `changelog: no`, Sam to bump version in release/v1.12, linter at 16:50, cutoff 17:00 PT. :thumbsup:

maria: Pinged for marketing blurb where needed. Good luck everyone!
